description: This file serves as the entry point for a React.js web application, initializing the app by rendering the <App /> component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the root renderer and wraps the app in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues during development.

methods.name: createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React rendering root for the specified DOM element.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a React element tree into the root.
